2   Code findings

Critical SQL Injection CWE-89 Injection api/reports.py:142 · HIGH confidence
141owner = request.args["user"]
142cur.execute(f"SELECT * FROM reports WHERE owner = '{owner}'")
143rows = cur.fetchall()
What's wrong

Request-controlled `owner` is interpolated into the SQL string.

Remediation
Vulnerable
cur.execute(f"... owner = '{owner}'")
Secure
cur.execute("... owner = %s", (owner,))
Illustrative CVEs
CVE-2019-19844CVE-2021-23336
Critical Command Injection CWE-78 Injection worker/convert.js:88 · MEDIUM confidence
88exec("ffmpeg -i " + src + " out.mp4")
What's wrong

Untrusted `src` is concatenated into a shell command.

Remediation
Vulnerable
exec("ffmpeg -i " + src + " out.mp4")
Secure
execFile("ffmpeg", ["-i", src, "out.mp4"])
High Hardcoded Credentials CWE-798 Secrets config/settings.py:12 · HIGH confidence
12STRIPE_KEY = "sk_live_abcd" + "••••"

A live API key is committed to source control.

Remediation
Vulnerable

Medium Weak Password Hashing CWE-328 Crypto auth/users.py:57 · MEDIUM confidence
57digest = hashlib.md5(password.encode()).hexdigest()
What's wrong

MD5 is unsuitable for password storage.

Remediation
Vulnerable
hashlib.md5(password.encode()).hexdigest()
Secure
bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode(), bcrypt.gensalt())
